faq.question: Q1. What organisation is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Lucknow University is conducting the recruitment through the Institute of Management Sciences (IMS).

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for Subject Experts in German and French for MBA/BBA Programmes.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 9 October 2026 at 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report to IMS, Second Campus, Lucknow University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be eligible as per UGC norms for engaging Subject Experts in German and French.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. Will TA or DA be provided for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA and DA will be given for the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original marksheets, degrees, credentials, and a self-attested set of photocopies of all documents.
